sources.transformations: Validate ZIP CRC, sole ordinary member and exact header/count/UTF-8/plaintext hash. Preserve original forms, reading, English raw senses and source line. Project supported v1 tone-number syllables to existing inventory; isolate unsupported/mixed readings, budgets and conflicts; merge exact duplicate evidence. Stable source identity excludes mutable English senses. No word frequency/POS inference; no automatic script conversion.
sources.scope: Licensed full fixed CC-CEDICT mirror archive and derived word/pronunciation/gloss data; not independent language quality acceptance.
limitations: Full fixed mirror archive, not current official latest release and not publisher-signed.
Descriptive dictionary with raw English senses; no complete POS, modern frequency, bilingual sense alignment or independent language-accuracy proof.
Unsupported syllables, r5, non-pinyin and mixed tokens remain isolated; production parser inventory unchanged.
No heldout annotations or dictionary-derived gold. All missing frequency remains null/unknown.
